description: Pause a Batch job's current run: it picks up no new tasks until batch_resume. Tasks already in flight still finish and bill; for a hard cost stop use batch_cancel. A paused run still counts as an active job. Idempotent; a run that already ended answers with its final status and already_ended:true.

job_id.description: Batch job id returned by batch_create or batch_list

name: batch_pause
